items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; questionable and affects Justin Herbert projections heavily. Game at 4pm ET.
items.why: Ribs; practiced some but key uncertainty.
items.implication: If out, LAC WR targets to Johnston/others; Herbert volume/ceiling drop.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets if active; monitor for GTD.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury for Sunday vs Bengals. Injury not believed serious but enough to miss Week 2.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in Wednesday practice; DNP Thu/Fri.
items.implication: HOU WR room thinned; look to Hutchinson/Noel/Boutte and Schultz for targets.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints.
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy to Bateman/Lane crumbs; Andrews target bump possible.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers due to knee, per HC.
items.implication: Michael Mayer or other TE usage rises; LV pass game impacted.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut; Patriots desperately need playmakers—do they give him 10+ touches vs Stevenson?
items.implication: Potential RB2/flex with 10+ touch upside; Stevenson handcuff reverse if expanded.

items.text: Joe Burrow listed questionable (back) but said he's playing for Sunday at Houston.
items.why: Burrow self-reported playing; Q on report.
items.implication: Full CIN offense expected; Chase/Higgins/Brown usage normal.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN for Sunday vs Ravens.
items.implication: Squeezes Etienne/Miller committee; Kamara lead back.

items.text: AJ Brown listed OUT or DOUBTFUL for Sunday.
items.implication: NE WR targets to others; Diggs/McLaurin etc. rise.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status does matter for SF RB depth.
items.why: Week 1 usage strong; Black Q impacts handcuff/backup role.
items.implication: CMC RB1 lock with elevated touches if Black limited.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE: Back in after tough W1; 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT, 3 deep looks; @ TEN soft secondary (85% catch rate allowed).
Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (tied lead), 74% snaps, 40% routes targeted in W1; vs IND who gave up big to Henry. Could finish RB1 overall range.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization score (tied Bijan lead) in W1; 19% target share recent; @ LAC soft run D.
items.why: Elite util + passing involvement post-injury scare overreaction.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% target share, all RB RZ touches, more routes than Gainwell in W1; vs CLE soft run.
Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% target share from Wentz in W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz; @ CHI soft vs WRs.
